notes.title: Territory – Alpha 7 – Unreal Engine 5.6
notes.content: [h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Upgraded project to Unreal Engine 5.6 (Latest Release)[/p][/*][/list][p]This should bring some overall performance improvements and gives me more tools to use in development. Note this will be a large download due to the new engine version.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting the Alpha 7 run.[/p]

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.52 – New Quest System
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Quest System that is fully multiplayer ready.
[*] Only 2 Main Mission Quests to begin with while I work on more main mission and side quest types such as kill, collect and craft quests.
[*] In multiplayer other players can be invited to join quests so they can be completed together.
[*] Interested in ideas for quest types and ideas for where the story line should go.
[/list]

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.51.1 – Loot Balancing
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Randomised loose item spawn timers and increased max respawn times
[*] Reduced global container item spawning by another 10%
[*] Reduced chance of resource car spawns
[*] Reduced chance of some random resource spawns
[*] Decreased early game aggressive roaming enemy spawns some more
[*] Added Gunpowder mixture to traders for Buy and Sell
[*] Improved Locked Crate spawn code and set spawn chance to 15%
[/list]

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.51 – Early Game Balancing
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented level scaling for aggressive roaming enemies spawns for players up to level 20 so that new games are less frustrating to get going. The aggressive roaming enemy spawn chance will gradually scale up from level one to 20. Note: POI’s will still have aggressive enemies from the start of new games so low level players will need to be careful near these areas
[*] Enemies will now only attack the players base if the player is within 100m so they will only attack your base if you are alive and in the immediate area so have a chance to defend it
[*] Reduced deadliness of ranged bandits
[*] Reduced Global loot item spawning by 40%
[/list]

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.50 – Multiplayer Fishing
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed fishing to new system that is replicated for multiplayer
[*] Changed fish to integrate with new fishing system so the fish you see is the fish you catch
[*] Reduced inventory weight of a lot of items
[*] Reduced build part destroy sound effect volume
[*] Reduced bandit assault rifle sound effect volume
[/list]
The fishing system is very complex and will need improvements. Currently you will have to try to throw your hook on or in front of fish or find a group of fish for the best chance of catching one. It will need balancing for sure. Let me know how it goes and I will tweak numbers of fish and catch chances etc

I am working on an advanced fishing rod that will have a longer casting range and higher bite chance as well as other features.

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.44 – Railway System
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[h3]Buildable railway system[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/837ee0a422c6ba26e8e50a5548ee7d783b4f3436.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/a77f89b1269e2c06580a3abef6bdde7a8f7d195b.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Craft the railway build part, place then add sections to the track with iron ore and wood.
[*] Turn the track left or right as you add sections.
[*] Track pieces will adapt to the terrain autmatically but not where it's too step (over 55 degree slope) 
[*] Currently you cannot close the loop, that will come later at some point.
[*] You can set the cart to stop at the end of the track or automatically travel up and down the track automatically until you stop it.
[*] You can hop on the cart and travel with it to your resource gathering area, then fill it with resources and ride it back home.
[*] Tracks and carts save with your save game.
[*] Replicated for multiplayer.
[/list]

[h3]2 Types of carts:[/h3]
[h3]Flatbed Cart[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/b3e2b5c5d557b97b7e08beea44e96249073d7e61.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Only small storage but easier to place things on to move around on the flatbed
[*] Crafting on the crafting bench and breaking down on the extractor for all rail items
[/list]

[h3]Container Cart[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/d9f8a100d994cfaf418250e9539345484c50680e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Holds whatever you need to transport in its huge storage
[/list]

[h3]Playtesting video:[/h3]
[url=https://streamable.com/d7tkth]Railway Testing Video[/url]

Notes:
[list]
[*] Currently you can have multiple carts on the same track they will just overlap when they pass each other which is fine for now.
[*] You can send carts to stop at the end of the track or set them on automatic to loop back and forth when they reach the end of the track.
[*] Get your track build resources back when you remove track pieces so you have freedom to pack up tracks and redeploy as required.
[*] Currently cannot attach other build parts to the carts but this will come at some point.

[h3]Sunlight[/h3]
Plants are affected by sunlight, they need light to grow so wont grow inside if they are covered. Currently plants will still grow at night if not covered but this will change when soon when I add electric grow lights for indoor growing.

[h3]Temperature[/h3]
Plants are affected by temperature, they will grow better when its warmer and yield more when harvesting.

[h3]Fertilizer[/h3]
Plants can be fertilized with ammonium. (Which is made by recycling spoiled foods in the primitive recycler)

[h3]Sickness[/h3]
Sick plants can be cured with Copper Sulphide mixture (Crafted on the crafting bench with copper ore, sulphur and nitrate)

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.37.8 – Attack System Improvements
notes.content:
[h3]Attack System Improvements[/h3]
The random attack system has been revamped so players should now see more conistent random attacks. Here are some things to note:

[list]
[*] You must have attacks turned on in the game settings for whichever attacks you want enabled or you can disable them all if you do not want random attacks.
[*] Attacks are based on player level - some light attacks from levels 1 to 10, then they gradually start ramping up after level 10.
[*] Attacks are currently only based on the player location, so they could happen when you are not at your base.
[/list]

[h3]Game Difficulty[/h3]
If the game is too easy and there are not enough aggressive enemies roaming the map (not random attacks) then remember to go to game settings and increase the percentage of aggressive roaming AI.

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ranged weapons Aim offset animations not working (character not aiming up and down)
[*] Animal melee attacks colliding with landscape and spawn zones
[*] Ranged Bandits stop attacking
[*] Inconsistent dynamic event spawn system
[*] Raid AI bad navigation
[/list]

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.30 – Difficulty Settings and AI Spawn Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[h3]Difficulty Settings[/h3]
The following game settings have been added to allow players greater control the game difficulty and better suit how they like to play these kind of games.

[h3]No Aggressive AI[/h3]
Some players may want to just build and survive without any threat from aggressive AI. With this setting enabled the only AI that will spawn are Deer and Escapees. More passive AI types for hunting are coming soon. 

[h3]No Aggressive Roaming AI[/h3]
Enabling this setting will make it that aggressive AI will only spawn at POI’s such as cabins, towns and military bases etc. No aggressive AI will spawn outside of these areas. Passive AI will still spawn and roam around the map as usual.

[h3]Aggressive Roaming AI %[/h3]
For a more granular control, this percentage will determine the chance of a passive or aggressive AI spawning outside of the POI’s (roaming). The higher the percentage the more hostile AI will be roaming around the map.

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.26 – Water
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[h3]Dirty Water and Clean Water[/h3]
[list]
[*] All lakes and dams are now dirty water sources.
[*] You can drink dirty water in an emergency and it will fill your thirst 8 points but decrease health 25 points.
[*] You cannot fill metal water bottle containers with dirty water.
[*] Players will need to find a clean water source (wells or tanks) to fill their water containers or craft their own water (rain) catcher.
[*] Wooden wells can no longer be crafted. I will look at this later possibly using it as a water storage that you transfer water to from the rain catcher or something like that.
[*] A more advanced later game stage water making system will come in due time.
[*] Water/Rain Catcher craft balanced – it is now:
[/list]
150 Wood
20 Tarp
1 Duct Tape
2 Rope

Clean water tank sources have been added to each of the military bases. You can try to fill your containers there… if you dare!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/18fc7bd2f649fe699c7bf57a0ea6f4ffca74e679.png[/img]

There are also clean water wells located at the Large Hunter Cabins
These water sources are limited but you should be able to fill your containers there most of the time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/256f4ed9bd6e4352ee558774555d013f45bdafd5.png[/img]

[h3]Plastic Dirty water bottle[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/10341ab7596336c62ab966f1dce3d11ea14b14f2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can fill empty clean plastic water bottles at dirty water sources which will give you a filled dirty water bottle. You can then boil the water on a cooking device (Campfire or Gas Stove) to purify it enough to drink. This is not a fast process. (Campfire 3 mins, Gas Stove 90 secs, Chemical Station 60 secs)
[*] You can fill empty dirty plastic bottles at a clean water source to recieve a clean plastic water bottle.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thirst and Hunger damage now decreases health 5 points every 25 seconds. Therefore, if you’re at 0 thirst or hunger you will start dying but slowly enough that you should at least be able to keep yourself alive for long enough to come up with a solution.
[*] Plastic water bottle now only has 1 consumable use of 30 thirst points.
[*] Rope craft adjusted – is now 35 plant fibre and 1 duct tape
[*] Tarp and plastic spawns increased a little
[*] Tweaked Origins fog
[*] Reduced dust and snow trail sound effect volume
[*] Map Icon colour scheme changed to be less wacky
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[*] Water volume and drink zone scale
[*] Tree stumps too dark
[/list]

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.18.8 – Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]

[h3]Drop all items on death[/h3]
All player items will now drop onto the ground when players die and items will save with the save game so as long as you remember where you died you can always retrieve your stuff. I figure the game is pretty challenging already without losing a bunch of good stuff especially when dead player bodies glitch out or something else strange happens when trying to get back to your body. Items will still despawn after some time so it is advisible to retrieve them asap. I may revisit this mechanic for changes in the future.

[h3]Interaction[/h3]
Items that have multiple options such as Hold, Equip and Pickup can no longer be picked up with proxy interaction you will need to point at the item and choose an interaction option. Everything that is single option can be interacted with the “F” key proxy interaction. This is handy for picking up lots of junk from the ground.

[*] Farm Animals (Pigs) being despawned when player is far away

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 6.17 – Going Underground
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/2f4e1105e9ecd612358bc4d06228a2dadd2a2de7.png[/img]

[h2]Added[/h2]

[h3]Caves[/h3]

The first of many under ground areas, currently very simple areas for testing and feedback, there will be random enemies that spawn and ores to mine. The underground adds a whole new element to gameplay and there is lot’s of potential to expand on this. Potentially (with a lot of work) there could be a complete network of caves underneath the map. I won’t restrict building in there at this point however it will probably be quite uncomfortable to build a base underground unless you like a challenge… we’ll see how it plays out.

The test cave is marked as a POI on the world map. It is not advised currently to take your vehicle inside as you will probably lose it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/10496b49eeec2ee80eca138eafcad7f4e5713329.png[/img]

[h3]New Resource – Copper Ore[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/8b9ddb02ecd49413e0219ad4fd55aae4199d35fa.png[/img]

Can be found (quite rare) in nodes around the map and more frequent in caves. The nodes be harvested for raw copper ore. This can then be smelted on the stone or iron furnace into copper ingots

[h3]New Resource – Gold Ore[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/58e5649b30125841b86fc4fc1d51e9971e125933.png[/img]

Can be found (very rare) in caves. The nodes be harvested for raw gold ore. This can then be smelted on the stone or iron furnace into gold ingots

[h3]New Resources – Ammonium Powder and Ammonium Nitrate[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/61c5e25751af0faca7bd277139d6c001cfdb5a9a.png[/img]

Ammonium Powder is crafted by recycling decomposed organic materials (meat and veg – currently only spoiled meat, meat stew, apples and tomatoes). Ammonium Nitrate is then crafted by combining ammonium powder with nitrate on the workbench.

[h3]New Item – Stone Lamp[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/d94e07c2ccb2a8e345ed3518795f75a9e6f7e38c.png[/img]

Crafted on the workbench using stone and ammonium nitrate as a slow burning fuel for an organic light source.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/96493e719e0ed74612bdedcb49ddaf85cc430bfb.png[/img]

[h3]New crafting recipe – Copper Wire[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/24b1e67759632855100d1ea52c753da954601d48.png[/img]

Can be crafted with copper ingots and plastic.

[h3]Additional [/h3]

Also added spoiled tomato item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/1ccbba0f906dfa445400b5fb42041b0431a68e98.png[/img]

Reminder that decomposing food items can be sped up by placing them in a composter.

[/list]

notes.title: Territory - Alpha 6 - Map Size Increase
notes.content:
Increasing the map size sets the baseline for all the improvements planned in Alpha 6. The focus is now going to be on adding more POI's and resource areas that players will need to travel around the map to source what they need. The new world map system sets up the framework to build and improve the dynamic events sytem that I've been planning for some time.

This update may not add a hell of a lot of new things to see and do but it definitely has changed the game and sets a path for many improvements on the next few months. I'm keen to hear feedback and ideas for POI's and resource gathering areas as well as feedback on performance and gameplay balancing in general. Links to all the community pages below the patch notes.

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Origins map
[*] Greatly Increased the size of the map
[*] Added Ocean, Coast and large bay areas
[*] Added Fishing Village
[*] Added Rivers around map
[*] Moon Phase now starts full and overall brightness has been increased a little
[/list]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qYBR66PTnHY]Video showing map size increase[/url]

Some pics

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/4378e02721b9d53a6492b4d9c64f9a381f075e7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/632b97144da60fc605a0ea59ba1a42f8c88c4a11.png[/img]
[h2]New World Map and Minimap[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgraded world map and compass and added minimap.
[*] World map now has fog that needs to be cleared and you explore
[*] Player can add waypoints to the map that show in the world

[h3]Default Keys[/h3]
[*] World Map – M
[*] Minimap toggle – O
[*] Minimap toggle zoom level – J
[*] You can right click on the world map to add waypoints
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character meshes not changing in multiplayer
[*] Day count not updating on game load
[*] Traders not spawning
[*] Enable/Disable zombies setting
[*] Fixed AI getting stuck on quad and applying too much damage
[*] Improved Quad physics so its less floaty and easier to handle
[*] Player not exiting Quad before it blows up
[*] Quad destroyed effects too loud
[*] Increased pickup mass so it’s not so floaty
[*] Menu UI issues
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dynamic music no longer triggers for passive animals
[*] Suicide Key (Default K) now needs to be held down for a second before it kills the player
[/list]
[h2]Performance[/h2]
The AI and resource spawning systems have been recoded to be a lot more controlled. This was necessary due to the map size increase but ended up being a massive improvement to how spawning is managed to optimise performance.

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
The price of the game has been reduced (pending Steam review) because nobody is buying or playing the game.

This is mostly due to the toxic reviews that have been at the top of the reviews page as the "most helpful" despite the overall reviews being positive. This happened due to 2 players what did not like the way I responded to thier requests and subsequent removal of them from the discord server. All it took was for them to post 2 very negative reviews and spam them with community rewards so they remain at most helpful status. This is really all it takes to destroy the momentum of an early access game.

If you want to support indie games and thier developers please rethink your interactions and reviews especially when they are trying to build. You want to know why so many EA games fail? Toxic and selfish players that do not understand the Early Access process and do not know how to support indie developers. That is why. Not because they just give up or take the money and run, and that is why all we get as gamers is the same old regurgitated crap that the AAA studios pump out.

I have not made any money from this game, I have spent much more on it than I've made back in sales. Not to mention the income lost from time spent working on it. The reason for making this game was because I wanted to try and make something unique. Yes, the same tried and true survival formula, but something unique and memorable at the same time because I was tired of trying to find that in other games.

I added the Zombies almost out of desperation because all of a sudden there were so many great new survival games coming out and I felt like Territory in comparision was really not competitive. Honestly, I had worked on the game so hard and for so long that my vision became clouded. As I spend more time at a distance from it, that cloud is fading and my original vision is starting to return but it will take some time.

I still have that core vision, I just need to work out how to get back to it from where the game is at now. It was never meant to be overly complicated with NPC's and quests and other BS, the original vision was a simple and refined tower defence/survival game where the core game play was to gather resources, loot and build up a fortress that you defend from enemies using weapons and traps. I became too accomodating with players requests and tried to do too much which ended up burning me out. But then again, we all know what happens when people don't get what they want right?

Anyway that's all for now, I started this journey being fully transparent so might as well keep doing that. If that ends up being the downfall of the game then so be it. At the end of the day I can just walk away and at least say I tried.

ThreatVector

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Not giving up. Too stubborn for that. However, I do need a break.

I started working on this game 12 months ago and worked on it almost 7 days a week 12 to 15 hours a day. It still needs a lot of work but at least it is currently in a stable playable state. In it's current form, the game is probably not even 25% of the vision I have for it but unfortunately Rome can't be built in a day.

From this point there will be longer times between updates but the updates will be much larger.

Thank you everyone who has supported Territory so far. 

Cheers!
ThreatVector

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 5.61 – Adjustments
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Magazines can now be attached and detached without holding the weapon. This allows easier weapon attachment and ammo management in the inventory
[*] Stamina reduction and recharge balanced
[*] Dropped Items are now considered unwanted and will now despawn after 2 hours game time (saved timer). This is required in order to prevent save game issues and poor performance for extended game saves where there are lots of items being dropped in the world, as these all need to be saved.
[*] To prevent an item from despawning, pick it up and place it using world move (default key – middle mouse click). This allows players to place items wherever they want to decorate their base.
[*] Apologies but this change will likely result in some lost items that have been dropped without being placed and have already been on the ground for 2 hours.
[*] Increased all ammunition min and max damage. Damage amounts are more randomised but overall all ammo damage has been increased to balance with player speed and A.I difficulty.
[*] AI Assault rifle firing rate reduced
[*] Water catcher recipe now requires 30 Tarp
[*] All farming growth times increased a bit
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update - Jan 2023 - I need your help.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Happy New Year to you all, I hope you had a decent break and have started the year off strong!

Territory is really starting to come together now. I've been focusing mainly on ironing out bugs and refining the core gameplay experience through constant gameplay testing (you can see some of that on the games [url=https://www.youtube.com/@territorygameofficial/videos]youtube channel[/url]. Also with the help of my wiz kid dev we've been adding and improving some really nice features and improvements to the game. 

There's still so much work to do and the game is still not anywhere near where I want it to be and where it will be in another 6 months time. But, I feel like at this point the game speaks for itself as far as it's potential to be a really good game and I feel like I can now confidently ask for help to take it to the next level. 

The truth is that currently the game has cost much more to make than it has made back in sales which is fine I knew that would be the case for a while until it hits a certain point and to be honest it's been better to have slower growth because more people and players just increases pressure, especially when things break as you would have seen that happens often. 😅

I currently work full time doing cyber security and develop Territory on the side, it would be amazing if I could go full time developing because once Territory is done, I have so many games I want to make, Territory will be the first of many. (I have ideas for space exploration, tactical turn based and ARPG games)...

So what I need now is help to boost the game in Steams algorithm to bring more players in as I'm now happy for more players to come in and experience the game and provide feedback to help improve. If you've read this far it probably means that you care enough, either good or bad to help me out and write a review. It can be positive or negative, that doesn't matter and it doesn't have to be war and peace, just write what you do and do not like about the game. This will help so much so thank you in advance.

Other than that, I might open a patreon or something similar for those who would really like to support Threat Vector for the development of Territory and games in the future. Let me know your thoughts on this.

That's all for now, I might start doing these updates monthly. See how we go.

Threat Vector (Alex)

Pic for attention

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 5.41 – Move Furniture and Decay
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[h3]Furniture Moving[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buildpart furniture such as farm planters, chests, campfires, candles, lanterns etc. can now also be moved with world item move (default key is mouse wheel click). Base buildparts such as foundations, walls etc cannot be moved like this, they need to be dismantled with a hammer and rebuilt.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[h3]Stack and Decay[/h3]
[list]
[*] All consumable items can now stack. A stack of a consumable item such as raw meat will decay at the same time as the first item in the stack, which means if you have an older stack and add a fresh item to the stack it takes on the stacks decay time so be careful which items you are stacking together. It is too complicated and resource intensive to have the stacks keeping track of each item and it’s decay time. Rust removed decay because of this reason so this is the trade off in order to have both decay and stacking for these consumable items. Keen to hear feedback and ideas on this.
[*] Apple now satiates some more
[*] Coin now stacks 1000
[/list]
[h2]Known Issue[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sometimes the primitive bow can bug out and arrows won’t spawn to be collected. For now if this happens just drop the bow on the ground and pick it back up.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone thanks for playing and thanks for the great feedback. A lot of people can see the amount of work that's gone into the game so far this year and the potential for the future.

Currently with the help of my contracted devs we are working through some issues with performance after updating the engine version to 5.1. So at the moment performance won't be great though it still should be playable. (you may have to reduce some video settings to get a smooth framerate)

There was a really awesome response to the Dead City asset locations that I added in last week and I think they look really good and suit the game quite well. The game was not originally meant to have a post apocalyptic aesthetic but they do kind of suit the setting and the lore anyway and they just look amazing, so I'll be adding some more of these locations around the map to explore and loot.

As for the enemies at these locations currently I have soldiers there (looting and pillaging) but this may change later on. The easy way out is to add zombies to the game but this is something I'm desperately trying to avoid as I want Territory to be something different and stand out from the rest. Any Ideas for some different types of A.I enemies either ranged or melee are welcome, anything is possible and will be considered.

Coming up over the end of year break and into the new year we'll be working on the following, 

[list]
[*] Performance Optimisations
[*] Fixing Issues with Farm Planters (Search and Add water functions and MP replication issues)
[*] Fixing issues with weapon recoil system post updating to UE5.1
[*] Adding more map locations to Origins map
[/list]

I've also had some really good ideas for some new systems which I'll be starting to implement in the new year:

[b]Threat System[/b]
Based on a mixture of player level and day count the threat system will manage where the player has been and who they pissed off, as well as other more random attack events. The goal here will be to provide a dynamic experience that keeps the player guessing but also provide players with an indication of when some of the larger attacks will occur so there is something to plan against. 7 Days to Die does this well because it gives players some idea of what is coming and when which creates drive and motivation to improve fortress defences.

[b]Hidden Map Locations[/b]
This one is really exciting because it opens up so many possibilities for dynamic gameplay. The plan with this is that there will be caves, underground bunkers, internal office locations and some other secret locations 😊 that the player will teleport to by entering a door or cave entrance or something (think Skyrim style entering a cave). The current idea for this is that they will be high risk high reward areas where you could lose all the gear you have on you on death or if successful you come out with a full swag of goodies and XP. These areas would be very interesting in Multiplayer as combat PVP zones.

The Origins map is quite small but having the ability to have endless additional internal areas opens it right up. The issue is larger map sizes come with a whole heap of complications for performance and are just a lot more difficult to manage as an indie dev. That being said I am still working on a larger map which may or may not come to the game. We will see how it goes in the new year.  

All of the current and upcoming works can be found and tracked via the Territory Trello board here: [url=https://trello.com/b/8kVsmUCM/territory-game-development]Territory Game Development Trello[/url]

Come and let me know your ideas or report bugs either in the forums or on discord.
[url=https://discord.gg/up6tns6Jzc]Threat Vector Discord[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2062940/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url]

Youtube to check out some of my gameplay vids
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUkRO2CQWetrgE6leDNWbsA]Territory Game Official Youtube[/url]

Cheers!
ThreatVector

[list]
[*] Implement 1st person archery

For now enjoy these tasty updates. I do recommend starting a new game because quite a bit has changed and you may experience bugs however you should be able to continue on old save files to finish a video series or something. In the new central town area there is 1000 wood and 1000 stone (in loot box on top of the sewer hatch in front of the ferris wheel) for those that lose their base due to the map changes and no build zones around trader houses.

notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
3 New Game Settings have been added:

[list]
[*] Hunter Attacks Enabled
[*] Raider Attacks Enabled
[*] Visitor Attacks Enabled
[/list]
These can be found in the game settings menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/6721c90e3ef4a0c6141fccb4789b7acd42af2e3f.png[/img]

These settings enable players to disable the dynamic attacks on their base if that’s how you want to play the game. Just be aware that these attacks are a core part of the game design and gameplay loop so only uncheck if you are certain that you only want to build, craft, farm and explore in your own time. The game will be a much slower and chill experience without the attacks.

The intention of the attacks in the gameplay loop is to give players a reason to build up their base defenses and repel attacks. The attacks will become more forceful as you level up your character.

You will still have the regular roaming hunters and other animals that can spawn near your base.

I'd like to hear feedback on this and ideas for some other game options moving forward, cheers!

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi all, just a quick update to let you know what's happening with Territory and what to expect over the next couple of months.

Updates have currently slowed down and the main reason is because we're doing some work behind the scenes to get Territory set up so that multiple developers can work on it simaltaneuosly and from anywhere in the world. This will allow us to hire talented and experienced developers to help take Territory to the next level.

Apart from that, personally, I really needed to slow the pace for a bit to ensure I don't get burnt out. I've worked really hard on the game 12 hours or more a day, 7 days a week for about 5 months straight and it does start to take a toll!

Currently the game is stable enough that players can have a playthrough without too many issues, but it is still nowhere near where I want it to be. There are still some serious issues that need to be addressed.

Once we get the backend infrastructure all set up and ready to go the plan will be to continue refining, optimising and balancing what is already in the game so that there's a solid Alpha release for players just to absorb. Once it's at this point, we can focus on implementing more content such more weapons, enemies, new maps, CO-OP and Multiplayer, Main story and other quest lines.

Territory at it's core is a survival game, it's been inspired by games like 7 Days to Die, Subsistence, Rust, Ark etc. Within these games is the core survival gameplay loop which has infinite replayability. That is what I want to capture for Territory. I want it to be one of those games you can come back to whenever you feel like, start a new game and enjoy that solid core survival gameplay loop. 

I've wanted to build this game for years and the vision I had in my minds eye was to create the same type of survival game that invokes fear and emotion by immersing you deeply with atmosphere. Anyone who has played the games listed above will understand what I mean, an example I always think about is once you've built a little shack and claimed your "Territory" whenever you're in your base and you hear someone or something outside of your base you get that wave of fear and panic. To me, that is what makes games in this genre so fun. Then the endorphin rush of exploring and looting. There's nothing quite like it.

Anyway enough rambling. Stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

Threat Vector

[b]New crafting resources:[/b]
[list]
[*] Animal Fat – Harvested from animals. Used to craft bio fuel.
[*] Bio Fuel – Looted and Crafted. Used as a slow burning fuel for all things that make fire (except gas stove) and for electricity generation when it comes.
[*] Copper Wire – Looted. Will be a resource used for advanced crafting - electronics and electrical.
[*] Hide – Harvested from animals. Used to craft leather on the leather tanning rack.

notes.title: Territory – Alpha 3 – Tutorial, Quests and XP/Level System
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm pleased to release Territory Alpha 3 which features a Tutorial, Quest System and XP System. These foundational systems unlock many possibilites for the game moving forward. I hope you enjoy, come and join the discord and let me know what you think!

[url=https://discord.gg/up6tns6Jzc]Threat Vector Discord[/url]

[url=https://trello.com/b/8kVsmUCM/territory-game-development]Territory Game Development Trello [/url]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[h3]Starting Tutorial [/h3]
[list]
[*] To teach new players the basic controls
[*] Can be skipped for experienced players
[*] Will only run on the first gameplay session
[/list]
[h3]Quest System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Two Crafting Tutorial quests that follow on from the initial tutorial
[*] Two Main story starting quests to set the scene and tone
[*] There are currently 7 repeatable quests based on killing NPC’s
[*] Repeatable quests will be available randomly based on their difficulty and rewards
[*] Quest Hub communications structures added around the map to offer quests and give out rewards.
[*] Quests can be accepted and handed in at any Quest Hub
[/list]
[h3]XP and Leveling System[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Currently XP is gained from completing quests, and killing NPC’s.
[*] Currently there’s a Max of 50 Levels, with a new cool rank title every 10 levels.
[*] Raider attack logic rewritten to utilise player rank in order to determine attack frequency and difficulty
[/olist]
[h3]Various other additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some New World map icons
[*] Another music track added to the mix
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] AI drop bags spawning in air
[*] M1982 Firing rate to match cocking animation and audio
[*] M1982 Firing sounds – dropped the lame ones kept the big boom boom ones
[*] Wooden Well wasn’t crafting. Fixed it and made a crafting discount to make up for Losossos lost wood
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Saving and Loading Games
[*] Loading games from the in game menu has been removed as it was causing a lot of issues with the new quest and XP systems and is just unnecessary. All save games will now need to be loaded from the main menu. Thank You for coming to my TED talk.
[*] 7.62x54R (Mosin Rifle) Rounds damage buffed to make the weapon more viable
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Quest Window UI has issues with keyboard shortcuts but the mouse works fine
[/list]

notes.title: Territory Alpha 2 - Released
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I’m very happy to release Alpha 2 to you all today. There has been a lot of great additions to keep players busy and I’ve also managed to start the basis for some really cool systems coming in future updates. This update is a mixture of content and quality of life improvements.

Due to a big issue I ran into that set me back a day, I ran out of time to do more of the map improvements I had planned however I did manage to add some other nice features such as the loot crates which will add a new dynamic to the game. See below for a list of everything new, changed and fixed in Territory Alpha 2. Due to the amount of changes to the game it is recommended to start a new game and delete your old save files.

As always please come to our discord or the steam discussion forums and let us know if you find any bugs and what you do and don’t like about the game. You can find us here:

[url=https://discord.gg/up6tns6Jzc]Threat Vector Discord[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2062940/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forums[/url]


Also, here is the Territory Game Development Trello board where you can see known bugs, what is currently being worked on and planned ideas for the future:

[url=https://trello.com/b/8kVsmUCM/territory-game-development]Territory Game Development Trello Board[/url]

[h2]Added[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added - New Time and Date HUD
[*] Added - Slight bit of camera shake to movement to alleviate some of the floating effect
[*] Added - Military Loot Crates now spawn randomly around the map. These special crates require lockpicks to access. Lockpicks can be found in loot, crafted on the workbench or purchased from traders.
[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Territory – Patch 1.7 – More Performance Optimisations
notes.content:
[h2]2nd performance optimisation pass[/h2]

I’ve heavily nerfed the LOD’s for foliage and converted the landscape to runtime virtual texturing in order to improve FPS. The trade off is the game doesn’t look as good as it did but at least it’ll run smoother. This will be ongoing work to find a balance between performance and visual quality.

Again, I’d appreciate any further feedback and information on performance issues because as an indie dev it’s hard to do a lot of testing on older GPU’s and systems. If you’re having problems with performance i.e. low FPS, stuttering, crashes etc then please come into the discord or steam discussion forums and give me your system specs and details on how the game runs for you so I have some more data to work with. Feel free to just dm me if you don’t want to talk publicly. Thanks

[h2]Added[/h2]

FPS Counter - Press F12

notes.title: Territory – Patch 1.6 – Performance Optimisations
notes.content:
[h2]Initial performance optimisation pass[/h2]

I’ve reduced the amount of triangles in all of the environment meshes (trees, rocks, landscape etc) and simplified their LOD’s (Level of Detail) so there’s a lot less demand on GPU’s. I was able to nerf quite heavily without losing much visually so can probably go a bit harder if needed.

I’d appreciate any further feedback and information on performance issues because as an indie dev it’s hard to do a lot of testing on older GPU’s and systems. If you’re having problems with performance i.e. low FPS, stuttering, crashes etc then please come into the discord or steam discussion forums and give me your system specs and details on how the game runs for you so I have some data to work with. Feel free to just dm me if you don’t want to talk publicly. Thanks

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
Fixed melee weapons disappearing when hitting flesh/harvesting body.
This took me longer than I’d care to admit to track this down. It was the blood particle effect disappearing and taking the weapon with it!

notes.title: Territory Patch 1.5 - Farming Added!
notes.content:
Hi all, thanks to all the early adopters and support for the game. I appreciate you all greatly. I have decided to push out a small content update prior to a larger one by the end of July. I haven’t received a hell of a lot of feedback but the feedback I have got is mostly asking for more content. I’ll take this as a compliment because it means that people think the game is stable enough and performs well enough to warrant the addition of more content. So here you go, enjoy!

[h2]Farming[/h2]
[url=https://streamable.com/3q9x98]Farming Video on Streamable[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/3b285175546ddecd0a7b10a8c1b3d3d98ae5ca43.png[/img]

This was something I actually had on my long-term goal list but I started looking into and got carried away. In this first iteration you will need to craft either the dirt patch planter or small wooden planter box and you will also need a water container (either a metal or plastic water bottle) with water in them in order to water the plants. If you can’t find a water bottle you can buy one from a trader.
The following limitations exist, these will come in later iteration of the farming system:

[list]
[*] Currently watering plants doesn’t use any of the water containers uses
[*] Currently you don’t need seeds to plant
[*] There are only 6 available plant types, some for consumables (blueberries and strawberries) and the rest provide plant fibre when harvested. This can be expanded massively if enough people like the farming and want more. I can add heaps (literally hundreds of different plants, fruit and Veg and trees etc)
[/list]
I’d really like feedback on the farming so if you like it please come into the discord and let me know and tell me what you do and don’t like.

[h2]Crafting Resources[/h2]
Wooden Pegs and Nails have been added in order to deepen the crafting and to make it more interesting and challenging. This is only the beginning of what will be an extensive (but still highly curated) crafting recipe framework.

[h2]World Item Meshes and Inventory Icons[/h2]
I’ve updated several of the world items (how things look when you drop them in the world) and the inventory icon thumbnail images. I’ll keep chipping away at these until they all look good.

[h2]Ambient Forest Sound Improvements[/h2]
The latest Unreal Engine hotfix forced me to reconfigure a lot of the sound cues and while doing this I tweaked the ambient forest sounds a bit so it sounds more immersive. I tried to reduce it so it isn’t in your face too much. Will monitor for further adjustments

[h3]Other Notable Fixes[/h3]
Bear Traps previously weren’t saving if they were set so you’d have to set them every time you loaded your game. This has been fixed and they now remember if they’re set or not.

Traders previously were not saving properly so I’ve now made their current form persistent in the world. This is temporary until the traders are worked on further. I’ve got some ideas for them but I’d like to hear from players where they should be and when. I want them to be accessible but not really as easy as they are now to find…

Again, thank you to everyone who has purchased the game and for seeing the potential. I am working very hard to improve it and give you a great game. I busted my gut to get the farming working but I am really happy with how it turned out for this initial iteration.

Please join the Threat Vector discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/up6tns6Jzc ]Threat Vector Discord[/url]
or come and say hello in the Steam community forums.

Also come and check out my Trello board where you can see everything I’m currently working on and future ideas. [url=https://trello.com/b/8kVsmUCM/territory-game-development]Territory Game Development | Trello[/url]
Threat Vector

notes.title: Territory Alpha 1 Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42567561/24d48586812426189fa24ae75df743627a1b2e7f.png[/img]

Finally after several months of non stop work (blood, sweat and literal tears as UE5 continued to crash relentlessly) Territory is available as Early Access.

Thanks for all who wishlisted on a promise. I was blown away at how many wishlisted so quickly as the game has only been listed as coming soon for a couple of weeks. 

I've tried to make the game as stable as possible for the initial single player release but there are bugs some of which I've listed in the pinned post in the bug reporting section of the discussion forums.
Please report all bugs you come across in there and I'll collate to them all to fix in the coming updates.

Currently the game is lacking some content, my goal for initial release was core gameplay, stability and atmosphere/immersion. Within the next 3 weeks I plan to release an Alpha 2 which will be content heavy to keep you guys busy for longer. 

i.e. 

[list]
[*] map improvements 
[*] POI's
[*] deepening crafting and looting (more items and advanced crafting)
[/list]

I have a huge list of long and short term goals and ideas which I will have up in the discussion forums soon for anyone that wants to be involved in shaping the games direction. I welcome your input and ideas.

See you in the forums,

Cheers

Threat Vector aka Territory Dev
